overview: This paper proposes WS-COC, the first MLLM-driven weakly-supervised framework for class-agnostic object counting, which bootstraps MLLMs using only image-level count supervision through three strategies: divide-and-discern dialogue tuning (D3T), compare-and-rank count optimization (CRCO), and global-and-local counting enhancement (GLCE).

modules.name: Data Preprocessing and Instruction Construction
modules.description: Prepare datasets (e.g., FSC-147), parse image-level counts and categories, and construct text instructions and ground truth responses for baseline, D3T, and CRCO tasks using specified templates.

modules.name: Count-Aware Image Sampling
modules.description: Implement the sampling strategy for CRCO that groups images by object count intervals and samples sets of images with strictly increasing counts within the same category to ensure coverage of sparse and dense scenes.

modules.name: MLLM Backbone and LoRA Initialization
modules.description: Initialize the Multimodal Large Language Model backbone and integrate Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) layers for parameter-efficient fine-tuning.

modules.name: Baseline Count Prediction Pipeline
modules.description: Implement the naive baseline logic that directly fine-tunes the MLLM using simple question-answer templates to map images to absolute object counts via auto-regressive generation.

modules.name: Divide-and-Discern Dialogue Tuning
modules.description: Implement the D3T strategy, which iteratively constructs multi-round dialogues by asking range judgment questions, progressively narrowing down the count range until a threshold is met, then predicting the exact count.

modules.name: Compare-and-Rank Count Optimization
modules.description: Implement the CRCO strategy, which takes multiple sampled images as input, instructs the MLLM to rank them based on object counts, and computes the language modeling loss against the ground truth ranking.

modules.name: Multi-Task Training Workflow
modules.description: Manage the training loop, combining losses from the baseline count prediction, D3T, and CRCO tasks, handling gradient updates, epoch iteration, and LoRA parameter optimization.

modules.name: Global-and-Local Counting Enhancement
modules.description: Implement the inference-time GLCE strategy that partitions dense images into smaller sub-images, queries the MLLM for local counts on each sub-image, and fuses these with the global count to mitigate underestimation.

modules.name: Evaluation Metrics Computation
modules.description: Calculate Mean Absolute Error (MAE) and Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) on full test sets, as well as on specific subsets like sparse scenes, dense scenes, and extremely dense scenes.

modules.name: Ablation Study and Hyperparameter Search
modules.description: Provide a modular framework to toggle individual components (D3T, CRCO, GLCE) and conduct hyperparameter sensitivity analysis for range narrowing thresholds, sampling group sizes, partition grid sizes, and dense scene thresholds.

modules.name: Cross-Dataset Validation
modules.description: Evaluate the trained model on unseen counting datasets (e.g., CARPK, PUCPR+, ShanghaiTech) to assess cross-dataset generalizability and zero-shot transfer capabilities without additional fine-tuning.

modules.name: Dense Scene Data Augmentation
modules.description: Implement a data augmentation technique that concatenates multiple images of the same category from the training set to synthesize extremely dense scenes, augmenting the training data for better handling of dense counts.

modules.name: Visualization and Error Analysis
modules.description: Generate attention maps highlighting the correlation between count-related text tokens and image patches, plot MAE against average object size, and visualize qualitative counting results for error analysis.

modules.name: Experiment Configuration and Logging
modules.description: Handle configuration parsing for model architectures, dataset paths, and prompt templates, while integrating with monitoring tools for tracking training losses and validation metrics.
